changes: Canonical operation reads now use current agent credentials and approved Server profile independently of physical launch evidence.
Workspace drift, local binding removal and revoked local binding state no longer prevent historical queries; new runtime mutations still require the approved mapping.
Credential changes during a query discard its response; preexisting credential rotation can be used on a subsequent explicit read.
Public parsed CLI start/submit/steer/interrupt/stop commands resolve and admit over real loopback HTTP and dispatch through automatic daemon WSS/Core ownership.
Every command is replayed with the same intent ID; final evidence asserts five operations, five receipts, one native opening and one dispatch attempt per operation.
CLI operation queries read all five final receipts from the actual Server.

failure_history.finding: The new five-operation assertion was initially inserted after only open/submit. It was moved after all five actions; the same product code then passed.

limitations: Positive runtime integration uses a technical native peer and fixture-only Server readiness qualification. It is not evidence for actual Pi, Codex or Claude.

Registration, realization and initial operator approval are supplied by the established onboarding fixture. Public Connector prepare/apply then recovers that approved proposal before runtime CLI admission.
Existing onboarding TCP cases separately cover CLI configuration/realization and binding application; no single real-provider end-to-end onboarding campaign is claimed.
Nexus production bytes and its installed wheel are unchanged from a0c6160. The new Nexus commit adds tests only.
Core production bytes and wheel remain unchanged at a061960 / 0.2.43.
Actual remote provider journeys, automatic session reuse, R4 status/logs, retention/pruning and final multi-host/platform acceptance remain pending.
Source and installed suites overlap; their counts are not unique test totals.
Preexisting Nexus UI asset changes remain outside commits and UI acceptance.
No milestone or release gate closes; M00-M13 remains the fixed objective.
